climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Sierra Foothills AVA of volcanic soils in Yuba County, California, with terraced vineyards in the middle and upper foothills. Cabernet Sauvignon is the main grape, alongside Syrah, Grenache, Viognier and Roussanne.
